description:
Today `register_event_handler/1,2` and `dispatch_event/4` are kind-blind. Components register handlers, dispatcher invokes every handler at the target slot regardless of what kind of event arrived. The web target gets kind-routing implicitly via separate DOM event names (keydown/keyup/click...) and HTMLEngine's per-attr wrapping; the TUI target has no such layer and ends up either swallowing release events globally or running every handler on every event_type.

## Goal

Make Filament Core model events as carrying a kind, and let handlers declare which kinds they want. Web-side HTML attrs and TUI-side hook sugar both compile down to the same Core primitive.

## API

### Registration

```elixir
@spec register_event_handler(function(), :bubble | :capture, kinds) :: String.t()
      when kinds: :all | MapSet.t(atom())

# Default kinds: :all (every event reaches this handler — backwards compatible)
def register_event_handler(handler, phase \\ :bubble, kinds \\ :all)
```

Existing 1- and 2-arity calls keep working with kinds = :all.

### Storage

`Filament.Fiber` gains two new fields:

```elixir
event_handler_kinds: %{non_neg_integer() => :all | MapSet.t(atom())}
capture_handler_kinds: %{non_neg_integer() => :all | MapSet.t(atom())}
```

Defaults to %{} (interpreted as 'no entry means :all' for backwards-compat with fibers built outside this API).

### Dispatch

```elixir
@spec dispatch_event(tree, fiber_id, slot, params, kind :: atom()) :: ...
def dispatch_event(tree, target_fiber_id, target_slot, params \\ %{}, kind \\ :all)
```

Capture-phase walk and target invocation both check: if the fiber's recorded kinds-set for that slot is :all or contains kind, run; else skip.

Existing 4-arity calls keep working with kind = :all (handlers fire as today).

## Done when

- Filament test suite green
- New tests cover: register with [:press], dispatch :press → fires; dispatch :release → skipped; dispatch :all → fires
- New tests cover capture-phase kind filtering symmetric to bubble
- Backwards-compat tests: 1-arity register + 4-arity dispatch behave identically to today

## Out of scope

- Updating HTMLEngine's `on_keydown` / `on_keyup` transforms to use the new kinds-set (existing components keep their current behavior).
- Defining what 'kind' atoms are — that's a backend concern; Core is agnostic.
- TUI integration (separate octo_pi ticket consumes this API).
title: Event handler kinds: register with a kind-set, dispatch filters by kind
